content.scenario: A consumer in Mumbai files a complaint with the Central Authority regarding a defective product. The Central Authority directs its Investigation Wing to conduct an inquiry into the matter.
content.outcome: The Central Authority shall conduct an inquiry or investigation into the complaint as directed by the Central Authority, under the provisions of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

user_queries: What is the role of the Central Authority in consumer complaints?
How does the Central Authority handle inquiries?
